_note: Model labels use the form <crop>__<condition>. General, non-dosage guidance. Confirm with a local agriculture officer or KVK before choosing any plant-protection product.

groundnut__early_leaf_spot.title: Early leaf spot (groundnut)
groundnut__early_leaf_spot.description: A fungal leaf disease causing brown spots, often with a yellow halo, on groundnut leaves.

groundnut__late_leaf_spot.title: Late leaf spot (groundnut)
groundnut__late_leaf_spot.description: A fungal disease with dark, rough spots mostly on the underside of leaves, causing leaf drop.

groundnut__rust.title: Rust (groundnut)
groundnut__rust.description: Orange-brown pustules on the underside of leaves.

cotton__leaf_curl.title: Cotton leaf curl
cotton__leaf_curl.description: A viral disease spread by whitefly that curls and thickens leaves.

cotton__bacterial_blight.title: Bacterial blight (cotton)
cotton__bacterial_blight.description: Angular water-soaked leaf spots that turn brown; can reach bolls.

paddy__blast.title: Rice blast (paddy)
paddy__blast.description: Spindle-shaped leaf lesions with grey centres; can also affect the neck of the panicle.

paddy__brown_spot.title: Brown spot (paddy)
paddy__brown_spot.description: Oval brown spots on leaves, often linked to stressed or nutrient-poor crops.
prevention: Keep nutrition balanced via soil test

paddy__bacterial_leaf_blight.title: Bacterial leaf blight (paddy)
paddy__bacterial_leaf_blight.description: Yellow to white stripes along leaf edges that dry out.

redgram__wilt.title: Wilt (red gram)
redgram__wilt.description: Plants yellow and wilt, often in patches, linked to soil-borne fungus.
monitoring: Split a stem to look for dark streaks

healthy.title: No disease detected
healthy.description: The model did not find a supported disease in this image.
